summary: Fixed CWE-486 (Comparing Classes by Name) in the bad entry point of CWE486_Compare_Classes_by_Name__basic_14. The code compared the two helper objects using getClass().getSimpleName().equals(...), which treats two distinct classes in different packages as identical because they share the simple name. Replaced the name-based comparison with a direct comparison of the Class objects (getClass().equals(getClass())), which reliably distinguishes the classes while preserving the feature of reporting whether they are the same or different.
